Yes. I found several Toronto-area teams that appear to cover both sides of the journey: making Reels/short-form content and improving what happens after someone clicks through.

Strong matches

Social Signals Marketing — Toronto creative-growth studio offering short-form video for Reels/TikTok/Shorts plus conversion-focused website design, paid ads and automation. This is particularly close to the “Reel → landing page → lead” setup you described.

Whissel Strategies — Toronto agency combining video production, marketing and conversion-focused website development. Their web process includes testing and optimization.

Arnold Street Agency — social-first Toronto agency combining short-form content, creator/influencer partnerships, paid media and digital strategy. Good if the “creator” side is especially important.

Synonym Social — North York/Toronto team doing end-to-end Reels/TikTok content (planning, scripting, filming, editing) alongside social strategy, SEO/web optimization and branding.

Brand Vision Marketing — Toronto agency with web design/development and digital marketing, with an emphasis on tying design to conversion and business goals.

Narsaik — perhaps the most literal match to your description. They say they create the Reel, ad, landing page, post, follow-up and proof block from the same production system, and offer both Toronto video production and conversion-focused websites/landing pages. 
Narsaik

Manisoft Media — explicitly combines Instagram Reels/content creation with lead-generation systems, conversion-focused messaging and Meta advertising for Toronto businesses. 
Manisoft

The Iconic Management — produces Instagram commercial videos and also offers a full Meta funnel with custom landing pages, tracking and campaign optimization. 
The Iconic Management

Viterno Group — Toronto short-form specialist handling strategy, filming, editing, posting and growth. Their public offering is more content-heavy, so I'd specifically ask whether they will optimize the destination page too. 
Viterno Group

What I'd look for

If your actual goal is “make Reels that get the right people to click, then make the page convert those visitors”, I'd prioritize a provider who can own this entire chain:

Hook → Reel → CTA → profile/link click → landing page → inquiry/booking → tracking

That is materially different from hiring a normal Reel creator. Narsaik, Social Signals, Manisoft and The Iconic Management are especially explicit about connecting content to conversion rather than stopping at views. 
Narsaik
+2

+2

If you tell me what kind of business/page this is (e.g. restaurant, clinic, realtor, SaaS, personal brand, local service), I can narrow this to 5 Toronto providers and compare their services, portfolios, pricing where publicly available, and who actually seems capable of doing both the Reels and landing-page optimization.
